title: Spa part of mall world
content: Bro I entered a spa area of mall world two nights ago where my mom left me and ran off somewhere else to do her thing but EVERY worker looked so pissed I was there even though I had a haircut / facial appt lol. Like straight up left me halfway through appointment and they didn’t finish the services. Anyone else? Super elegant high ceilings red and gold accents looked like a country club . Like I can’t emphasize enough how mad the staff was that I was there lolol
